title: 乌衣巷
author: Liu Yuxi

translation: wild grass and flowers grow beside the rosefinch bridge
the setting sun slants across the entrance of black robe lane
the swallows that once nested before the halls of wang and xie
now fly into the homes of ordinary people

appreciation: The grand bridge is overgrown and the noble lane lies in slanting sunlight, but the swallows keep returning to the same eaves. Once they nested in the mansions of the great Wang and Xie clans; now they fly into ordinary homes. The poem matters because it lets a bird carry the whole lesson of history, showing how dynasties fall while daily life quietly goes on.
